first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus Belfast-specific archive-internal DTM tile filenames and an authoritative Belfast City 2006 CRS statement. This unused official OSNI River Basin LIDAR guidance window states that River Basin LIDAR position is expressed in Irish Grid coordinates and elevations are relative to Mean Sea Level Belfast, and documents the 1 km square grid/index and ASCII raster directory structure; however the same guidance explicitly states that no data is available for the city of Belfast due to copyright constraints. Therefore those River Basin coordinate-system statements are not transferred to the separate Belfast City 2006 Cyient dataset, and no Belfast tile filename, geometry, CRS binding or parcel binding is fabricated.
